hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $p$.

$\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{35}} = \dfrac{\red{6}}{\blue{10}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{35}} = \dfrac{\red{18}}{\blue{30}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{35}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{6}}{\blue{10}}}{\green{\dfrac{3}{5}}}$

Multiply each side by $35$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{35} \times \dfrac{\red{p}}{\cancel{\blue{35}}} = \green{\dfrac{3}{5}} \times 35$
